verdict.rationale: The pack lists the online filing flows (Express Annual Report, online formation, foreign LLC registration, online closure). None of it publishes operating-hours windows, per-day filing limits, or session-timeout rules for those flows. The only related item is the in-person counter's same-day service fee, which is a different channel and not an online-flow availability disclosure.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
